evidence.description: Both texts discuss the titled document Acts of God listing natural disasters plus fires and trampling incidents over 2000 years; both use the unusual phrasing 'I have rarely failed to rise to appropriately flavored ideological bait'; both discuss whether an all-powerful, good God causes mass disasters.
The 2016 introduction says the speaker rediscovered the document during office spring cleaning, while the 2024 edition describes an email asking discussion on the radio show.
Both identified as Tzav in their respective Hebrew years

finding: Very likely direct revision/reworking of the 2016 commentary into 2024 Beit Simcha sermon, not independently confirmed whether entire 2016 original was reproduced.
count_policy: Two separately published dated textual versions, one related sermon family; do not infer 2016 full text survived in full.
text_policy: Metadata and short comparative description only; original text lives at its sources.
